name: BEAM Basics
description: Common BEAM (.bas) code templates and patterns

snippets.name: Comment
snippets.description: Any of the four interchangeable comment styles
snippets.content:
rem this is a comment
' so is this
# and this (line start only)
// and this

snippets.name: Variable Assignment
snippets.description: Numeric and string variables (string names end in $)
snippets.content:
x = 42
name$ = "Alice"

snippets.name: Print
snippets.description: Print values, comma-separated; trailing ; suppresses the newline
snippets.content:
print "foo", a$, b
print "no newline";

snippets.name: Input
snippets.description: Read numeric or string input with an optional prompt
snippets.content: input "Enter your name: " a$

snippets.name: Line Input
snippets.description: Read a whole line, including spaces
snippets.content:
line input "Enter your name: " a$
print "Hello ", a$

snippets.name: If/Elsif/Else
snippets.description: Multi-line conditional block
snippets.content:
if (a = 1) then
  print "one"
elsif (a = 2)
  print "two"
else
  print "other"
endif

snippets.name: Single-line If
snippets.description: Short-form if with no then/endif (top-level only)
snippets.content: if (a <= 1 or a >= 4) error "Wrong, wrong !"

snippets.name: Switch/Case
snippets.description: Multi-way branch
snippets.content:
switch n
  case 0: print "zero": break
  case 1: print "one": break
  default: print "other"
end switch

snippets.name: For Loop
snippets.description: For/to/step/next loop
snippets.content:
for i = 1 to 10 step 1
  print i
next i

snippets.name: While Loop
snippets.description: While/wend loop
snippets.content:
i = 0
while i < 10
  print i
  i = i + 1
wend

snippets.name: Do/Loop
snippets.description: Infinite loop with break
snippets.content:
do
  a = a + 1
  print a
  if (a > 100) break
loop

snippets.name: Repeat/Until
snippets.description: Loop that executes at least once
snippets.content:
repeat
  x = x + 1
  print x
until x = 10

snippets.name: Sub (numeric return)
snippets.description: Return a value by assigning the sub's own name
snippets.content:
sub is_prime(a)
  local b
  for b = 2 to sqrt(a)
    if (frac(a / b) = 0) return false
  next b
  return true
end sub

snippets.name: Sub (string return)
snippets.description: A sub whose name ends in $ returns a string
snippets.content:
sub shout$(text$)
  shout$ = upper$(text$) + "!"
end sub

snippets.name: Static & Local Vars
snippets.description: local scopes a variable to the sub; static persists it across calls
snippets.content:
sub counter()
  static total
  local step
  total = total + 1
  step = step + 1
  print total, step
end sub

snippets.name: Array
snippets.description: Declare and use a numeric or string array
snippets.content:
dim scores(10)
dim names$(20)
scores(0) = 100
names$(0) = "Alice"

snippets.name: Pass Array to Sub
snippets.description: Pass a whole array by reference using empty parens
snippets.content:
sub print_words(w$())
  local i
  for i = 1 to arraysize(w$(), 1)
    print w$(i), " ";
  next i
end sub
print_words(words$())

snippets.name: String Operations
snippets.description: Common string built-ins
snippets.content:
full$ = first$ + " " + last$
print left$(full$, 2)
print right$(full$, 2)
print mid$(full$, 2, 1)
print upper$(full$)
print len(full$)

snippets.name: Error Statement
snippets.description: Abort the program with a message
snippets.content: if (a < 1 or a > 10) error "Value out of range"

snippets.name: Label/Goto
snippets.description: Jump to a label (prefer sub/end sub for new code)
snippets.content:
label mainloop
  print "looping"
goto mainloop

snippets.name: Gosub/Return
snippets.description: Call a labeled block and return
snippets.content:
gosub my_subroutine
...
end

label my_subroutine
  print "in subroutine"
return

snippets.name: File Read/Write
snippets.description: Open, read/write, and close a file
snippets.content:
open "data.txt" for reading as #1
while not eof(#1)
  line input #1, row$
  print row$
wend
close #1

snippets.name: Open Graphics Window
snippets.description: Open a drawing window and draw a filled circle
snippets.content:
open window 400, 400
color 255, 0, 0
fill circle 200, 200, 50

snippets.name: BEAM GUI Window
snippets.description: Open a BEAM widget window with a label and a close button
snippets.content:
win = beam_open(400, 200, "Hello BEAM")
while beam_running(win)
  beam_begin(win)
    beam_label("Hello, World!")
    if beam_button("Close", 80, 30) then
      beam_close(win)
    end if
  beam_end(win)
wend

snippets.name: Operators Reference
snippets.description: Arithmetic, comparison, and logical operators
snippets.content:
' Arithmetic:  +  -  *  /  ^  mod
' Comparison:  =  <>  <  >  <=  >=  ==
' Logical:     and  or  not
